mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS 3-month change < -0.25%) compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is fixed as positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3-month change < -0.25%, or the 20d return correlation with the signal is < 0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the 20d return correlation with the signal is < -0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.25%) and the CPI (CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%) signals a tightening monetary cycle combined with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.25% AND CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not significant (p>0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and is rising (3-month change > 0.1%), it signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% AND UNRATE 3-month change > 0.1%, or the 20d return correlation with the signal is < -0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100.0, it signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100.0, or the 20d return correlation with the signal is < -0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1100.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 104.0) signals a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100.0 AND INDPRO < 104.0, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not significant (p>0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is slowing (measured as the 4-quarter change in GDPC1 between -0.5% and 0.5%), it signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 4-quarter change is between -0.5% and 0.5%, or the 60d return correlation with the signal is < -0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 104.0, it signals weak supply conditions and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0, or the 20d return correlation with the signal is < -0.15 over a 5-year rolling window.
